title: A joint resolution providing for the reappointment of Steve Case as a citizen regent of the Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution.
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

This joint resolution reappoints Steve Case as a citizen regent of the Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution.

summary.headline: This resolution reappoints Steve Case to another term as a citizen regent on the Smithsonian Institution's Board of Regents.
summary.what_it_does: The Smithsonian Institution is run by a Board of Regents that includes citizen members chosen outside the government. This joint resolution gives Steve Case a new term as one of those citizen regents. The official summary does not describe any other changes to the Smithsonian or its rules.

who_it_affects.how: He continues serving as a citizen regent of the Smithsonian's Board of Regents for another term.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: The summary does not give a separate effective date; it was enacted on April 19, 2017.
